Conclusive returns require all nodes finite, so the determinant enclosure holds uniformly, excluding zero proves nonsingularity and common sign, and D={0} proves every member singular. Non-finite inconclusive runs assert no finite D; finite inconclusive runs have 0 in D but D is not {0}. Both assert no singularity/sign conclusion. Qualified F1 and repaired both proof steps without changing Statement, dependencies, page promise or choice requirements.
